sources.entry: I work as an independent consultant, helping organizations navigate the technical and organizational challenges involved in adopting Event-Driven Architecture. Find out about my services on //lutz huehnken _consulting*.

summary.title: Lutz Hühnken Consulting
summary.one_liner: Consultant homepage offering fractional CTO services, architecture consulting, and a 2-day in-person event-driven architecture training course.
takeaways: Lutz Hühnken offers fractional CTO and interim management services for startups and enterprises.
Architecture consulting covers cloud-native and event-driven backend design decisions.
A 2-day, in-person event-driven architecture course covers fundamentals, reliable consumption and failure handling patterns.
Public classes are held in Hamburg in German, offered together with partner oose; companies can also book the course for a whole team.
The site notes the consultant is currently fully booked but may take bookings for future engagements, training, and speaking.
summary.summary: This is the homepage of independent consultant Lutz Hühnken, presenting three services: fractional CTO and interim leadership, architecture consulting for distributed and cloud-native systems, and a hands-on 2-day event-driven architecture training course. The training description covers fundamentals, patterns for reliable consumption and failure handling, and lessons from real-world systems, with public classes in Hamburg taught in German alongside partner oose. The page also links to resources: speaking, a blog on reactive systems and event-driven architecture, a list of formative books, and the Awesome Event-Driven Architecture curated list. It is primarily a services page, so it contains few technical details beyond the course outline.
